provenance.source_generator: parsec-intake_v5 worktree: scripts/parsec/v5/collect.py, then a per-trial audit of all 680 trials, then scripts/parsec/v5/_pool_valid_trials.py for the 4 tasks that never reached 5 clean trials in one run (gitignored there -- vendored here as a frozen snapshot)

audit.tool: per-trial audit of harbor result.json / verifier / transcript for all 680 trials, every attempt
audit.method: cap-evolve itself counts only exceptions it catches; a gateway hang before the agent's first tool call (AgentTimeoutError, 0 tool calls) or a harbor exception reaches the raw ledger as a clean 0.0. Every one of the 680 trials behind this file's task_ledger was individually checked against its on-disk harbor result.json and agent transcript before being counted; 0 of the 680 final trial_rewards carry an unresolved infra problem.

pooled_tasks.note: 4 tasks (platform-034-rate-limit-not-an-outage, platform-111-recycled-sandbox-swallowed-teardown, platform-112-exec-pool-disk-not-the-bastion, platform-114-ee-nightly-float-not-a-commit) never produced 5 clean trials in any single run across repeated resubmission (recurring gateway hangs). For these 4, every individually-audited, error-free trial across EVERY attempt on disk for that task (the live run plus every prior .dead-* run) was pooled, and exactly 5 were drawn at random (seed=20261014, scripts/parsec/v5/_pool_valid_trials.py in the intake worktree) and averaged -- rather than requiring 5-in-one-run or declaring the task a failure.
